note: Point-in-time state. The live verdict for the equal-resource comparison is runs/benchmark-v2/independent-verification.json, not this file. If the two disagree, the verification file wins.
testsNote: 14 original adversarial tests plus 14 covering serialization, slot drain and resumption. Replayed on the compute host on 2026-10-31.

comparison.readsAs: Concurrency bought 18.5 percent of wall time and cost 3 accepted cases out of 24. No quality uplift; a measured quality loss.

honestCaveats: Concurrency shows no quality advantage here. It shows a measured loss of 3 accepted cases out of 24, alongside an 18.5 percent gain in wall time.
The two sequential arms agree on all 24 cases, which is what makes the parallel gap attributable to concurrency rather than noise.
Some abstentions are caused by the per-call deadline rather than by missing evidence. Timeout abstentions and evidence-based refusals are reported separately.
runs/development-initial used the rejected Qwen3-0.6B model and does not certify the final version. See evaluation/DEVELOPMENT_DISCLOSURE.md.
